notes.title: Early Access is OUT NOW!!!
notes.content:
After working on this game for almost a year , we are happy to announce the early access launch of our game.

This game is made by a team of 2 and we have worked very hard to make an enjoyable experience for all of you.

Yet our work hasn't finished and we would love to get as much feedback as possible as we continue towards the launch of our game!

Thanks!

notes.content:

notes.title: Pandamonium Demo has released!!!
notes.content:
Long awaited demo for our game Pandamonium has released. 

It's a pixel art action platformer/adventure game called Pandamonium. It's inspired by a lot of classic Nintendo titles like Mario and Zelda mixed with a bit of modern games like Hollow knight and Celeste.

We have taken quite a big risk by leaving our jobs and working on this game. The reason for this is we are extremely passionate about this project and because it's been our goal for quite some while.

Please do let us know what you think about it or any feedback on it will be much appreciated.

For those who have stuck along with us in this journey this is just a small stepping stone in the long journey ahead. Thanks for sticking with us :)

Thanks and Enjoy :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43103245/d6ef34d9b39d4b3444b7eab031eb7d92f037195b.png[/img]
